plan_warnings: The roc is the main risk: build it first and check it on stills at s 1 (legs and belly only), 0.42 and 0.36 before any acting. It must read as huge and kind.
The vertical valley needs two long camera travels (S16, S18); far layers of Library strips only do horizontal parallax, so the valley is its own module with a vertical translate.
Sinbad is small in the wides at 0.42 and 0.36 scale; the tangerine cloth and one arrow tag carry him. Check phone legibility on stills.
Sinbad lying strapped to the slab uses the front facing lie pose rotated with the slab; check the 90 to 0 degree turn at 118.2 on every second frame.
Only seven pauses: 8 short effects, all under 0.5 s; the LATER transition must fit 16.6 to 17.5.
This plan assumes the SIND-01 source exists when animation starts; if it does not, build dhow, openSea, harbourQuay and islandShore from the SIND-01 plan first.

New modules are above the usual four (roc, diamondValley with skyFlight and rim, woodedIsland with rocNest, snake, six props) because the story visits four new places; all are reusable and three reuse planned names.
